# XZ Embedded upstream source

This package contains the compact decoder from
[`tukaani-project/xz-embedded`](https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz-embedded),
pinned at the source retrieved on 2026-08-29.

The decoder source is unmodified. `Package.swift` and `xz_wrapper.c` provide
local Swift Package Manager packaging. XZ Embedded is distributed under the
0BSD license; see `LICENSE`.
